BrochureContent.Content:
Horgan Properties are delighted to present this charming 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom detached bungalow, occupying a generous site in a truly exceptional location along Ireland's world-renowned Wild Atlantic Way. Overlooking the renowned Ballybunion Championship Links Old Course, this unique property enjoys uninterrupted views across the famous links and benefits from a peaceful yet highly convenient setting, just a short walk from the town's miles of sandy beaches and excellent range of amenities.

Originally built in 1995 and extending to approximately 66.57 sq. metres, the property offers an outstanding opportunity to maximise the potential of this impressive site on the esteemed Sandhill Road. Positioned overlooking the 4th green and 5th fairway, there is considerable scope for extension or redevelopment, subject to planning permission, with the opportunity to further enhance the spectacular views towards the Atlantic Ocean and Loop Head. The accommodation comprises a bright and welcoming living room featuring a cast iron fireplace and solid timber herringbone flooring, which continues into the adjoining kitchen/dining room. The front door opens directly into the living room, while a rear door from the kitchen provides convenient access to the garden. There are three bedrooms, including a spacious double bedroom overlooking the rear garden with a fitted wardrobe, a smaller bedroom with fitted wardrobe, and a single bedroom to the front. The accommodation is completed by a family bathroom featuring a full-size bath, a hot press off the hallway, and an attic space providing excellent additional storage with potential for future development, also subject to planning. The property benefits from oil-fired central heating, double-glazed windows and connection to mains services. Externally, the property is approached through a gated entrance framed by a natural limestone wall, leading to a spacious gravel driveway providing ample off-street parking. Occupying an exceptionally generous and level site, the property is enclosed by block-built walls, mature hedging and planting, creating a well-defined setting. Expansive lawns extend to both the front and rear, while the uninterrupted views across the Championship Links Old Course stretches beyond the dunes to the Atlantic Ocean and Loop Head in the distance.

Ballybunion is renowned for its spectacular coastline, world-class golf links and relaxed coastal lifestyle. The property is within easy reach of Ballybunion Golf Club, a wonderful selection of pubs, restaurants and cafés, the leisure centre and swimming pool, Tinteán Theatre, and a variety of outdoor pursuits including water sports, coastal walks and the famous cliff walks. With the wider attractions of County Kerry all within easy driving distance, this location offers the very best of coastal living.

This charming property is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers, whether seeking a permanent residence, holiday home or investment opportunity. While the property would benefit from modernisation and upgrading, it presents an exceptional opportunity to create a truly special coastal home, making the most of its generous site, breathtaking views and outstanding setting overlooking one of the world's most renowned golf courses. Early viewing is highly recommended through the sole selling agents, Horgan Properties.
